name: Persistence Attempt via Registry Run Keys
description: Detects attempts to create or modify registry values in the common 'Run' keys (HKCU/HKLM) to achieve persistence. This is a very common technique for malware and PUPs to ensure they run at startup.

action.description: A process attempted to create or set a value in a startup registry key (Run/RunOnce) to establish persistence.

operational_usage: Investigate the process that made the change. Analyze the file path being added to the registry to determine if it is malicious. This is a high-fidelity indicator of persistence.
false_positive: Legitimate software installers (e.g., drivers, antivirus, productivity tools) frequently add entries to these keys to start components at boot. Context of the parent process is key to differentiation.
